items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And Stonzik says, "What? Get that book off the floor and put it back on the rack."

ctx.x: Yeah, with him. He plays everything, chimes, bells, marimbas and tom-toms and kettle drums and everything. He's got a whole space there, big as this room, for him, down in the pit. And he said, "Don't let him catch you with that book laying on the floor." And Stonzik says, "What? Get that book off the floor and put it back on the rack." See, you had to put it up there and play like you were reading it anyhow. See, you have to put it up there and look at it and turn pages anyhow, whether you know it or not. You…
